explanation: Pasado continuo: sujeto + <was/were> + verbo-ing. <She was cooking dinner>.
Pasado continuo con sujeto plural: <were> + verbo-ing.
Pasado continuo: <was> + verbo-ing para sujetos singulares.
Futuro con <will>: sujeto + will + verbo base.

correct: They will go to the beach.
explanation: Futuro con <will>: sujeto + will + verbo base.

correct: I am going to buy a new phone.
I'm going to buy a new phone.
explanation: Futuro con <going to>: sujeto + am/is/are + going to + verbo base.

correct: She is going to visit her grandmother.
She's going to visit her grandmother.
explanation: Futuro con <going to>: <She is going to visit>.
Pasado continuo: <I was watching TV>.

correct: We were walking in the park.
explanation: Pasado continuo con <we>: <were> + verbo-ing.
Futuro con <will>: <He will help his mother>.
Pasado continuo negativo: sujeto + was/were + not + verbo-ing.

source: They will come to the party.
correct: They will not come to the party.
They won't come to the party.
They'll not come to the party.
explanation: Futuro negativo: sujeto + will not (won't) + verbo base.

prompt: Change to a question in past continuous
explanation: Pregunta en pasado continuo: <Was/Were> + sujeto + verbo-ing?
Pregunta con <will>: <Will> + sujeto + verbo base?

source: They move to a new house.
correct: They are going to move to a new house.
They're going to move to a new house.
explanation: Futuro con <going to>: <They are going to move>.

correct: The children were singing a song.
explanation: Pasado continuo: <The children were singing a song>.

correct: I will eat pizza for dinner.
explanation: Futuro con <will>: <I will eat pizza for dinner>.
Pasado continuo: <She was writing a letter>.

correct: He is going to learn to drive.
He's going to learn to drive.
explanation: Futuro con <going to>: <He is going to learn to drive>.
Pasado continuo: <We were eating breakfast>.
